issues.title: Colliding item card borders
issues.description: Adjacent items touch directly without border collapse or separating gap.
issues.evidence: The bottom border of 'Signature haircut' directly meets the top border of 'Scalp treatment'.
issues.suggestion: Add a gap between cards or collapse adjacent borders in ItemGroup.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: ItemGroup had no border-collapse handling, so flush outline items + ItemSeparator stacked bottom border + hairline + top border into a doubled/colliding line; fixed with -mt-px child collapse in item.tsx.
